runs.query: Suggest a simple way for a household to organize weekly chores. Keep each role response under 100 words. The final answer should contain three concrete steps, one tradeoff, and state that no external actions were performed.
runs.result: Three steps: 1) Pick 5–7 recurring chores and assign each to one named person, rotating monthly. 2) Put the list on a shared paper or phone note with a weekly reset day (e.g., Sunday). 3) Do a 5-minute check-in on reset day to confirm completion and swap any missed items. Tradeoff: a fixed rotation is simple but can feel unfair if tasks differ in effort; mitigate by letting people swap tasks each month. No external actions were performed.
